response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff-level individual contributor with broad full-stack, systems, and embedded experience, but he has no demonstrated executive or leadership track record, no evidence of scaling engineering teams, no production multi-agent AI system experience, and no fintech-infrastructure depth (credit systems, payment flows, regulated environments). The role requires a CTO with 5+ years of senior technical leadership, team-scaling history, and hands-on production agentic-AI and fintech expertise, none of which is evidenced here.
strengths: Broad, deep technical versatility across web, backend, embedded, and systems programming
Some exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling in current role
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source leadership, workshops/teaching
concerns: No leadership or people-management experience — always an IC (Senior/Staff Engineer), never managed or scaled a team
No demonstrated production multi-agent AI system ownership — only brief, recent 'contributes to' AI-agent tooling mention
No fintech-infrastructure, credit-risk, regulatory, or compliance experience despite some fintech-adjacent employers (RIDE Capital, Optilyz)

key_factors.factor: No production multi-agent AI system experience
